A '''mem-stik''' or '''memory stick''' was a data storage device. The [[HiBaka 2000 mem-stik|HiBaka 2000]] was a model of mem-stik that could be hidden in the handle of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] when combined with a [[Rergo IV power condenser]].<ref name="Cracken">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>
